[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] '''Eksa Fa'kar''' was a [[Scholar/Legends|scholar]] by the time of the [[Third Galactic War]]. Fa'kar wrote ''[[Visions and Verities: A Collection of Essays on Myth, Symbolism, and Ritual within Voss Society]]'' about [[Voss (species)|Voss]] society.<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=codex|Interpreter's Retreat}}</ref>
